prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: Chaos, exactly as in Image 3: the same pooled void-black star-speckled robe hiding the legs, the black-and-gold armoured upper body, exactly two huge arms with gold-clawed gauntlets, the tall crown of living flame around the dark face with two blazing white eyes, and the ring of four orbs (frost cyan, ember orange, abyss teal, storm white), each orb touching the edge of the flame crown. FACE: the dark face with two blazing white eyes inside the flame crown is readable.

Pose: channelling the end of the world, a mirror-symmetric pose: both arms raised high with open clawed hands beside the burning head, the flame crown blazing brighter but no taller than in Image 3, its tips well below the top of the grey box; exactly four orbs and no fifth, the same four in the same places as in Image 3 (one above the flames, one on the left side of the image and two on the right side of the image), flaring brighter; exactly two arms; at the same pixel size as in Image 3, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Keep the frontal view of Image 3, chest and burning head toward the viewer, never turned to a side or three-quarter profile; exactly two arms, the arm on the left side of the image and the arm on the right side of the image, both separately visible and apart from the body, none hidden, merged or crossed; the pooled robe stays on the ground in every pose; the movement is in the arms, the flame crown and the orbs. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: a robed figure with no feet showing: the wide robe hem rests on the ground line in every pose and is its ground contact. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, four arms, six arms, legs, feet, wings, a tail, horns, a second head, a weapon, purple fire, violet, pink, magenta, a human face with skin, orbs floating apart from the body, a ground line.
